original_test_intent: Apply a bounded leak stimulus at the mapped connector sensor and verify detection, event correlation, drying and restored normal state.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Operator controls safe fluid/stimulus and physical recovery; agent collects sensor/SEL evidence.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: Correct sensor/event responds and fully clears after approved recovery.

historical_reviews.v3: RECLASSIFIED MANUAL ONLY to hybrid REQUIRES.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Qualified operator applies/removes/drys stimulus; collection/correlation is automatable.

master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Sensor/location map, approved fluid/amount/dwell, expected events and drying/recovery.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Read-only sensor inventory cannot complete leak detection.

original_method: Physical bounded leak stimulus plus management evidence.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the approved leak fixture/SOP and automated synchronized sensor/SEL capture.

safety_boundaries: Stop on spread or unexpected hardware impact
no_automatic_retry: No second stimulus after abnormal behavior.
review_improvement: KEEP: V3 correctly recognizes meaningful automated evidence without misclassifying operator stimulus as automatic.
